item.title: Why the U.S. is sending 2,500 marines to the Gulf — and what they might do there
item.summary: While U.S. President Donald Trump tries to convince allies to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz, he is also sending 2,500 marines to the region — the first deployment of U.S. troops since it and and Israel first attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

item.title: Stranded footwear and stuffed warehouses: How the Middle East conflict is hitting China’s economy
item.summary: For a snapshot of how the U.S.-led war in the Persian Gulf is affecting global trade and supply chains, look at Yiwu, China. Shipping containers of household goods are backing up as logistics come under pressure.

item.title: Iran hit by Israeli airstrikes as it vows to retaliate against U.S. industries in region
item.summary: Israel said on Monday it had detailed plans for at least three more weeks of war as it pounded sites across Iran overnight while Iranian drone attacks temporarily shut the Dubai airport and hit a key oil facility in the United Arab Emirates.

item.title: Israeli military expands operation in Lebanon as deaths mount
item.summary: Israel warned that displaced Lebanese driven from their homes by its military campaign would not be able to return until the safety of Israelis living near the border was ensured, as its troops pushed into new parts of southern Lebanon more than two weeks into its deadly offen...

item.title: Israel says Michigan synagogue attacker was brother of killed Hezbollah commander
item.summary: The brother of a man who attacked a Michigan synagogue last week, who was killed earlier this month in an Israeli airstrike, was a Hezbollah commander, Israel's military said Sunday.

item.title: Russian strike on Kyiv region kills 4, wounds 15
item.summary: A combined Russian missile and drone attack on the Kyiv region killed at least four people and wounded 15, a Ukrainian official said Saturday, after the United States postponed Russia-Ukraine talks due to the war with Iran. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the main...

item.title: Former NATO chief says he doesn't think allies will be pulled further into Middle East conflict
item.summary: The former secretary general of NATO says he doesn't think allies will be pulled further into the conflict in the Middle East, but he's concerned the ongoing war with Iran will benefit Russia's economy and take the world’s attention away from the invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Pakistan launches deadly airstrikes in Afghanistan as hostilities continue
item.summary: Afghanistan's Taliban government accused Pakistan's military Friday of targeting homes in overnight airstrikes in Kabul and other areas of the country, saying at least six civilians were killed and more than a dozen injured, as fighting between the neighbours entered its third...

item.title: Man in Michigan synagogue attack lost family members in Israeli airstrike in Lebanon, official says
item.summary: A man with a rifle who crashed into a large Michigan synagogue in what federal officials are saying was an attack had lost four family members in an Israeli airstrike in his native Lebanon last week, an official said Friday.

item.title: U.S. orders 2,500 marines, amphibious assault ship to Mideast after almost 2 weeks of war
item.summary: The American military has ordered 2,500 marines and an amphibious assault ship to the Middle East, a U.S. official said Friday, while Iran continued to launch widespread missile and drone attacks on Israel and neighbouring Gulf states.
